extDescription.message: Identify trading cards in duel videos and streams: select a Yu-Gi-Oh! card on screen to read its text in place. Unofficial fan tool.
extDescription.description: manifest.json 'description': shown in the Chrome Web Store listing and on chrome://extensions. Do not translate 'Yu-Gi-Oh!'.

bg_action_title_default.description: src/background/scan.ts DEFAULT_TITLE: the toolbar icon's tooltip/title, set after a successful scan. Also manifest.json action.default_title (__MSG_bg_action_title_default__). Do not translate 'Duel Lens' or the shortcut 'Alt+Shift+Y' (a literal key combo, kept as-is in every locale).

bg_restricted_page_title.message: Duel Lens can't read this page
bg_restricted_page_title.description: src/background/scan.ts RESTRICTED_PAGE_TITLE: toolbar icon tooltip when a scan failed on a page Duel Lens cannot script (chrome://, Web Store, etc). Do not translate 'Duel Lens'. Short (it's a tooltip).

bg_scan_failed_title.message: Duel Lens couldn't start the scan. Try again
bg_scan_failed_title.description: src/background/scan.ts SCAN_FAILED_TITLE: toolbar icon tooltip when a scan failed on a page Duel Lens CAN read. Short (it's a tooltip). Do not translate 'Duel Lens'.

bg_scan_failed_message.message: Duel Lens couldn't start the scan. Try again.
bg_scan_failed_message.description: src/background/scan.ts SCAN_FAILED_MESSAGE: shown as a one-line toast in the page (content script 'show-error'). Same wording as bg_scan_failed_title but a full sentence. Do not translate 'Duel Lens'.

bg_ai_error_auth.message: Anthropic rejected the API key. Check it in Options.
bg_ai_error_auth.description: src/background/ai.ts mapAnthropicError: shown as the AI check's error text when the Anthropic API key is invalid. Do not translate 'Anthropic', 'Options' (the Options page's name). 'Options' is the Options page's name: translate it exactly as common_options_label, the same word everywhere.

bg_ai_error_permission.message: This API key doesn't have permission for this request.
bg_ai_error_permission.description: src/background/ai.ts mapAnthropicError: AI check error text.

bg_ai_error_rate_limited.message: Rate limited by Anthropic. Try again in a moment.
bg_ai_error_rate_limited.description: src/background/ai.ts mapAnthropicError: AI check error text. Do not translate 'Anthropic'.

bg_ai_error_network.message: Could not reach the Anthropic API (network error).
bg_ai_error_network.description: src/background/ai.ts mapAnthropicError: AI check error text. Do not translate 'Anthropic API'.

bg_ai_error_api.description: src/background/ai.ts mapAnthropicError: generic Anthropic API error. $status$ is an HTTP-style status code (may be empty), $message$ is Anthropic's own English error text (not translated, passed through as-is). Do not translate 'Anthropic API'.

bg_ai_error_unknown.message: Unknown error talking to the Anthropic API.
bg_ai_error_unknown.description: src/background/ai.ts mapAnthropicError: fallback AI check error text. Do not translate 'Anthropic API'.

bg_ai_disabled.message: The AI check is turned off. Enable it in Options.
bg_ai_disabled.description: src/background/ai.ts identifyWithAi: shown when the user presses Ask AI but the AI check setting is off. 'Options' is the Options page's name: translate it exactly as common_options_label, the same word everywhere.

bg_ai_no_key.message: No Anthropic API key is set. Add one in Options.
bg_ai_no_key.description: src/background/ai.ts identifyWithAi: shown when Ask AI is pressed with no API key set. Do not translate 'Anthropic'. 'Options' is the Options page's name: translate it exactly as common_options_label, the same word everywhere.

bg_ai_refused.description: src/background/ai.ts identifyWithAi/testAi: Claude refused to answer (no category known). Do not translate 'Claude'.

bg_ai_refused_with_category.description: src/background/ai.ts identifyWithAi/testAi: Claude refused to answer, with Anthropic's own refusal category (short English token, not translated). Do not translate 'Claude'.

bg_ai_cut_off_retry.message: Claude's answer was cut off before finishing (ran out of tokens). Try again.
bg_ai_cut_off_retry.description: src/background/ai.ts identifyWithAi: Claude's reply hit the token limit. Do not translate 'Claude'.

bg_ai_no_answer.message: Claude did not return an answer.
bg_ai_no_answer.description: src/background/ai.ts identifyWithAi: Claude's response had no text block. Do not translate 'Claude'.

bg_ai_invalid_json.message: Claude's answer was not valid JSON.
bg_ai_invalid_json.description: src/background/ai.ts identifyWithAi. Do not translate 'Claude' or 'JSON'.

bg_ai_invalid_shape.message: Claude's answer was not in the expected shape.

bg_ai_test_disabled.message: The AI check is turned off.
bg_ai_test_disabled.description: src/background/ai.ts testAi: shorter variant of bg_ai_disabled, shown by the Options page's 'Test' button.

bg_ai_test_no_key.message: No Anthropic API key is set.
bg_ai_test_no_key.description: src/background/ai.ts testAi: shorter variant of bg_ai_no_key, shown by the Options page's 'Test' button. Do not translate 'Anthropic'.

bg_ai_test_cut_off.message: Claude's reply was cut off before finishing (ran out of tokens).
bg_ai_test_cut_off.description: src/background/ai.ts testAi: token-limit variant shown by the 'Test' button (no 'Try again' suffix, unlike bg_ai_cut_off_retry). Do not translate 'Claude'.

bg_no_ai_permission.message: The AI check needs permission to reach api.anthropic.com. Turn the AI check off and on again in Options to grant it.
bg_no_ai_permission.description: src/background/router.ts NO_AI_PERMISSION: shown when the optional host permission was revoked. Do not translate 'api.anthropic.com'. 'Options' is the Options page's name: translate it exactly as common_options_label, the same word everywhere.

bg_no_artwork_downloads.message: This version of Duel Lens doesn't download artwork: new cards come with its updates.
bg_no_artwork_downloads.description: src/background/router.ts NO_ARTWORK_DOWNLOADS: shown in the crop build (no remote images) when 'Update now' is pressed. Do not translate 'Duel Lens'.

bg_show_panel_gesture_error.message: Press Alt+Shift+U to open the side panel
bg_show_panel_gesture_error.description: src/background/router.ts SHOW_PANEL_GESTURE_ERROR: shown when 'Keep in side panel' can't open the panel itself (no user gesture) and the user must use the shortcut instead. Keep 'Alt+Shift+U' untranslated (the literal keyboard shortcut).

bg_recognize_failed_unexpected.description: src/background/router.ts 'recognize' handler: fallback error text when the recognition engine throws without a message.

bg_correct_failed.description: src/background/router.ts 'correct' handler: fallback error when picking another match fails to save.

bg_card_data_not_loaded.message: Card data isn't loaded. Open Options and check for updates.
bg_card_data_not_loaded.description: src/background/router.ts 'recognize' handler: shown in the popover when the engine matched a card id missing from the local database. 'Options' is the Options page's name: translate it exactly as common_options_label, the same word everywhere.

bg_ai_no_local_match.description: src/background/router.ts 'ask-ai' handler: shown when Claude's named card has no good local match. $name$ is Claude's answer text (English card name, not translated).

bg_board_unreadable.message: That board could not be read.
bg_board_unreadable.description: src/background/router.ts 'show-board' handler: the content script sent a malformed board.

bg_board_keep_failed.message: Couldn't keep the board for the side panel.
bg_board_keep_failed.description: src/background/router.ts 'show-board' handler: storage failed while saving the board.

bg_board_panel_closed.message: The board is ready: press Alt+Shift+U to open the side panel
bg_board_panel_closed.description: src/content/board.ts BOARD_PANEL_CLOSED: the side panel couldn't open itself (no gesture) after reading the whole board; shown as a toast in the page (content/app.tsx MESSAGES.boardDone path). Keep 'Alt+Shift+U' untranslated.

bg_open_options_failed.message: Could not open the options page

bg_test_failed_unexpected.description: src/background/router.ts 'test-ai' handler: fallback error text shown by the Options page's 'Test' button.

bg_check_updates_failed.message: Could not check for card updates.
bg_check_updates_failed.description: src/background/router.ts 'refresh-cards' handler: fallback error text (background's own wording; distinct from the Options page's own fallback 'Could not check for updates.', options_check_updates_failed).

bg_consent_save_failed.description: src/background/router.ts 'grant-consent' handler: fallback error text, shown on the welcome page's consent step.

bg_recognition_no_answer.message: The recognition engine didn't answer. Try again.
bg_recognition_no_answer.description: src/background/offscreen-client.ts recognizeViaOffscreen: the offscreen document gave no answer at all; surfaces as a RecognitionResult.error, which the popover shows as its lead message.

bg_detect_cards_unreachable.message: Duel Lens couldn't reach its card detector ($error$)
bg_detect_cards_unreachable.description: src/background/offscreen-client.ts detectCards: the offscreen document couldn't be reached at all. $error$ is a raw JavaScript error message (English, diagnostic, not translated). Do not translate 'Duel Lens'.

bg_detect_cards_no_answer.message: The recognition engine didn't answer detect-cards.
bg_detect_cards_no_answer.description: src/background/offscreen-client.ts detectCards: the offscreen document answered with nothing.

bg_detect_cards_unexpected.message: The recognition engine gave an unexpected answer to detect-cards: $details$
bg_detect_cards_unexpected.description: src/background/offscreen-client.ts detectCards. $details$ is a truncated raw JSON dump (diagnostic, English, not meaningfully translatable) - see catalog notes. This is an edge-case/diagnostic error string.

common_options_label.description: The Options page's own name, used as a standalone word/link label (page <h1>, nav links, 'Options' link text). Used in src/options/app.tsx and src/welcome/app.tsx. The Options page's name: every message that names the page uses this same word (options_page_title too). Chrome calls an extension's options page by its own localized word; match it.

common_disclaimer.message: Duel Lens is an unofficial fan tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by Konami.
common_disclaimer.description: src/welcome/copy.ts DISCLAIMER §1: shown on Options (About) and the welcome page footer, word for word from docs/release/disclaimers.md (copy.test.ts checks it matches). Do not translate 'Duel Lens' or 'Konami'. This is legally-reviewed wording - flag any change to the English source.

common_accuracy_notice.message: Duel Lens can misidentify cards, and its card data can be out of date, including banlist status. Check the card itself or the official Yu-Gi-Oh! card database before relying on it in a game, a trade or a tournament.
common_accuracy_notice.description: src/welcome/copy.ts ACCURACY §6: shown in Options → About. Do not translate 'Duel Lens'; 'Yu-Gi-Oh!' is a trademark, typically kept as-is.

common_legal_notice.message: Duel Lens is an unofficial, fan-made tool for the Yu-Gi-Oh! TRADING CARD GAME. It is not produced, sponsored, endorsed or approved by, or affiliated with, Konami Digital Entertainment, Konami Group Corporation or their affiliates, Studio Dice, Shueisha or TV Tokyo. Yu-Gi-Oh!, KONAMI and the names, text and images of Yu-Gi-Oh! cards are trademarks and copyrights of their respective owners (© Studio Dice/SHUEISHA, TV TOKYO, KONAMI). $dataSource$ from YGOPRODeck (ygoprodeck.com), which is not affiliated with Duel Lens either.
common_legal_notice.description: src/welcome/copy.ts legalNotice() §2: full legal notice, Options → About and the welcome page footer, word for word from docs/release/disclaimers.md (copy.test.ts checks it). $dataSource$ is common_legal_notice_data_images or common_legal_notice_data_only. Do not translate: Duel Lens, Yu-Gi-Oh!, TRADING CARD GAME, Konami Digital Entertainment, Konami Group Corporation, Studio Dice, Shueisha, TV Tokyo, KONAMI, YGOPRODeck, ygoprodeck.com. Legally-reviewed wording - flag any change to the English source.

common_legal_notice_data_images.message: Card data and card images come
common_legal_notice_data_images.description: src/welcome/copy.ts legalNotice(): fills $dataSource$ in common_legal_notice when the build includes remote card images.

common_legal_notice_data_only.description: src/welcome/copy.ts legalNotice(): fills $dataSource$ in common_legal_notice in the crop build (no remote images).

common_data_label_images.description: src/welcome/copy.ts attribution() and sidePanelCredit(): data-source label when the build includes remote images. Used before 'from YGOPRODeck' / ': YGOPRODeck'.

common_data_label_only.description: src/welcome/copy.ts attribution() and sidePanelCredit(): data-source label in the crop build (no remote images).

common_attribution.description: src/welcome/copy.ts attribution() §4/§8: credit line in the welcome page footer. $dataLabel$ is common_data_label_images or common_data_label_only. Source text is Markdown '[YGOPRODeck](https://ygoprodeck.com/)' rendered as a link; keep 'YGOPRODeck' untranslated. Do not translate the brand.

common_sidepanel_credit_tail.message: Unofficial fan tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by Konami.
common_sidepanel_credit_tail.description: src/welcome/copy.ts sidePanelCredit() §8: shortened disclaimer used only in the side panel's footer credit line (common_sidepanel_credit). Do not translate 'Konami'.

common_sidepanel_credit.description: src/welcome/copy.ts sidePanelCredit() §8, src/sidepanel/app.tsx Credit(): the side panel's footer line. $dataLabel$ is common_data_label_images or common_data_label_only; $tail$ is common_sidepanel_credit_tail. Do not translate 'YGOPRODeck'.

common_link_privacy_policy.description: Link text to the bundled privacy policy page (privacy.html, excluded from this catalog itself). Used in src/options/app.tsx, src/welcome/app.tsx footer, and the welcome consent step (src/welcome/copy.ts CONSENT.privacy).

common_link_licences.description: Link text to the bundled third-party licences page (licenses.html, excluded from this catalog itself). Used in src/options/app.tsx and src/welcome/app.tsx footer.

common_version_label.description: src/options/app.tsx About section and src/welcome/app.tsx footer: shows the extension's version number (from the manifest, not translated).

common_agreed_on_date.description: src/options/app.tsx About section and src/welcome/consent.tsx consent-done state: shown once the user has agreed to the first-run consent. $date$ is a locale-formatted date (not itself translated here).

common_press_the_shortcut_label.description: Fallback label shown instead of a rendered shortcut when Chrome's shortcuts haven't loaded yet. Used in src/welcome/app.tsx (Step 1 title) and src/welcome/demo.tsx (illustration).

common_press_shortcut.description: A short call to action with the scan shortcut's keycaps in it (the welcome page's first step and its illustration). $shortcut$ is drawn as keycaps, e.g. Alt + Shift + Y.

content_video_blocked.description: src/content/app.tsx MESSAGES.videoBlocked: shown as the popover's error message when a DRM/cross-origin video crops out black.

content_crop_failed.message: Couldn't read that part of the screen. Try again.
content_crop_failed.description: src/content/app.tsx MESSAGES.cropFailed: popover error message when cutting the crop out of the screenshot/video fails.

content_disconnected.message: Duel Lens was updated or restarted. Reload the page to scan again.
content_disconnected.description: src/content/app.tsx MESSAGES.disconnected: shown as a popover error message (a read that can't reach the background) and, separately, as a one-line toast (e.g. from 'Keep in side panel' or reading the whole board). Do not translate 'Duel Lens'.

content_no_answer.message: Duel Lens didn't answer. Try again.
content_no_answer.description: src/content/app.tsx MESSAGES.noAnswer: shown as a popover error message for a read with no answer, and reused as the AI check's failure detail (feeds into popover_ai_check_failed's $message$) when Ask AI gets no answer. Do not translate 'Duel Lens'.

content_panel_failed.description: src/content/app.tsx MESSAGES.panelFailed: one-line toast fallback when 'Keep in side panel' or the whole-board read can't open the side panel and the background gave no specific error.

content_matcher_failed.message: Duel Lens couldn't load its card matcher ($detail$).
content_matcher_failed.description: src/content/app.tsx MESSAGES.matcherFailed: popover error message when the recognition engine's result carries its own error. $detail$ is that engine error text (often one of the bg_* background strings, passed through). Do not translate 'Duel Lens'.

content_board_none.message: Couldn't read any of these cards.
content_board_none.description: src/content/app.tsx MESSAGES.boardNone: one-line toast shown after reading the whole board if no card could be read at all.

content_board_stopped.description: src/content/app.tsx MESSAGES.boardStopped: one-line toast shown when Esc or the bar's Stop interrupts reading the whole board.

content_board_done.description: src/content/app.tsx MESSAGES.boardDone: one-line toast after the whole board is read and sent to the side panel. $summary$ is board_summary, optionally with content_board_unread_suffix appended by the code.

content_board_unread_suffix.description: src/content/app.tsx MESSAGES.boardDone: optional parenthetical appended (after a space) to content_board_done's $summary$ when some outlined cards named no card. $count$ is how many.

board_summary.description: src/content/board.ts boardSummary(): 'N near, M far' - how many read cards are on each player's side. Shared by content_board_done (toast) and sidepanel_announce_showing_board (src/sidepanel/app.tsx). $near$/$far$ are counts; the code does not pluralize 'near'/'far' (they're side names, not counted nouns).

bar_reading_progress.description: src/content/selection.tsx scan bar: shown while 'Read the whole board' is in progress. Short (bar text is tight).

bar_reading_announce.message: Reading all $total$ cards. Esc to stop.
bar_reading_announce.description: src/content/selection.tsx scan bar's screen-reader status region, while reading the whole board. Note: the source code always says 'cards' here regardless of $total$ (no singular form, even for 1 card) - keep that behavior unless asked to fix it. Do not translate the key letter 'Esc'.

bar_corner_hint.description: src/content/selection.tsx scan bar: shown after the user clicks a first corner to draw a box with two clicks. Short (bar text is tight).

bar_corner_announce.message: Click the opposite corner. Esc to cancel.
bar_corner_announce.description: src/content/selection.tsx scan bar's screen-reader status region, same situation as bar_corner_hint. Do not translate 'Esc'.

content_matching_artwork.description: Shown while a read is in progress: the scan bar's box label (src/content/selection.tsx), the popover's skeleton state (src/content/popover.tsx COPY.scanning), and the status region's announcement. Short (bar text is tight).

bar_card_count_one.description: src/content/selection.tsx scan bar: how many cards are outlined, singular (count = 1). Short (bar text is tight).

bar_card_count_other.description: src/content/selection.tsx scan bar: how many cards are outlined, plural (count != 1). Short (bar text is tight).

bar_card_count_announce_one.description: src/content/selection.tsx scan bar's screen-reader status region, singular. Do not translate 'Esc'.

bar_card_count_announce_other.description: src/content/selection.tsx scan bar's screen-reader status region, plural. Do not translate 'Esc'.

bar_no_cards_hint.message: No cards found. Drag a box around one.
bar_no_cards_hint.description: src/content/selection.tsx scan bar: shown when detection finished and found nothing to outline. Short (bar text is tight).

bar_no_cards_announce.message: No cards found. Drag a box around one. Esc to exit.
bar_no_cards_announce.description: src/content/selection.tsx scan bar's screen-reader status region, same situation as bar_no_cards_hint. Do not translate 'Esc'.

bar_drag_hint.message: Drag a box around a card
bar_drag_hint.description: src/content/selection.tsx scan bar: default hint before any detection/outlines exist. Short (bar text is tight).

bar_drag_announce.message: Drag a box around a card. Esc to exit.
bar_drag_announce.description: src/content/selection.tsx scan bar's screen-reader status region, same situation as bar_drag_hint. Do not translate 'Esc'.

bar_finding_cards.description: The scan bar's status (shown and read aloud) while the card detector looks for cards on the frozen picture, for up to a second or two.

layer_dialog_label.description: src/content/selection.tsx: aria-label of the scan-mode overlay (the modal dialog), read by screen readers when scan mode opens. Do not translate 'Duel Lens'.

bar_esc_stop.description: src/content/selection.tsx scan bar: follows the literal key label 'Esc' (e.g. 'Esc to stop'), shown while reading the whole board. Do not translate 'Esc' itself (rendered separately). Very short.

bar_exit_hint.description: src/content/selection.tsx scan bar: follows the literal key label 'Esc' (e.g. 'Esc to exit'), the default state. Do not translate 'Esc' itself (rendered separately). Very short.

bar_corner_cancel_hint.description: src/content/selection.tsx scan bar: follows the literal key label 'Esc' (e.g. 'Esc to cancel'), shown while a first corner is armed. Do not translate 'Esc' itself. Very short.

bar_stop_button.description: src/content/selection.tsx scan bar button: stops reading the whole board. Short (bar button).

bar_read_all_button.description: src/content/selection.tsx scan bar button: reads every outlined card (same action as the B key). Short (bar button). Also quoted verbatim inside welcome_step3_body3 (src/welcome/app.tsx) - keep the two in sync if changed.

bar_exit_label.description: src/content/selection.tsx: aria-label of the scan bar's ✕ button, which leaves scan mode. Do not translate 'Duel Lens'.

bar_help_with_board.message: Tab goes through the cards, Enter reads one, B reads them all. Space or K leaves and plays the video again.
bar_help_with_board.description: src/content/selection.tsx: screen-reader-only instructions shown once cards are outlined and reading the whole board is offered. Do not translate the key letters/words Tab, Enter, B, Space, K.

bar_help_no_board.message: Tab goes through the cards, Enter reads one. Space or K leaves and plays the video again.
bar_help_no_board.description: src/content/selection.tsx: screen-reader-only instructions when reading the whole board isn't offered (e.g. no cards outlined). Do not translate the key letters/words Tab, Enter, Space, K.

bar_help_no_cards.message: Space or K leaves and plays the video again.
bar_help_no_cards.description: src/content/selection.tsx: the scan layer's screen-reader help (#dl-how) while no card is outlined. Keep the key names Space and K.

popover_face_down.message: Face-down card: nothing to read yet.
popover_face_down.description: src/content/popover.tsx COPY.faceDown: the popover's lead message for a face-down card. Also used verbatim as the status region's announcement.

popover_face_down_hint.message: Scan it again once it is turned face-up.
popover_face_down_hint.description: src/content/popover.tsx: second line shown under popover_face_down in the popover body.

popover_no_match.message: Couldn't match this. Frame the whole card, or just its artwork.
popover_no_match.description: src/content/popover.tsx COPY.nothing: popover lead message when nothing matched a box the user dragged.

popover_no_match_picked.message: Couldn't read this card. Pause on a sharper moment, raise the video quality, or drag a box around just its artwork.
popover_no_match_picked.description: src/content/popover.tsx COPY.nothingPicked: popover lead message when nothing matched a card picked from the detected outlines.

popover_no_match_truncated.message: Part of this card is outside the picture. Try when it's fully in view, or box just its artwork.
popover_no_match_truncated.description: src/content/popover.tsx COPY.nothingTruncated: popover lead message when the card runs off the edge of the picture and nothing matched.

popover_low_match_multiple.message: Low match: could be one of these.
popover_low_match_multiple.description: src/content/popover.tsx COPY.suggested: shown above the chips when the engine offers several low-confidence candidates.

popover_low_match_single.message: Low match: this could be it.
popover_low_match_single.description: src/content/popover.tsx COPY.suggestedOne: shown when the engine suggests exactly one low-confidence candidate.

popover_no_card_announcement.description: src/content/popover.tsx COPY.noCard: the screen-reader status region's words when nothing was found.

popover_low_quality_tip.message: Raise the video quality for a better match
popover_low_quality_tip.description: src/content/popover.tsx COPY.lowQuality: tip shown when the source video is 480p or lower.

popover_copy_blocked.message: Copying is blocked here. Select the text instead.
popover_copy_blocked.description: src/content/popover.tsx COPY.copyBlocked: shown when the clipboard write for 'Copy text' fails (e.g. page policy).

popover_asking_ai.description: src/content/popover.tsx: the 'Ask AI' button's label while waiting for an answer, and the status region's announcement during that wait.

popover_ai_check_failed.description: src/content/popover.tsx: shown both in the status-region announcement and as a note under the Ask AI button when the AI check errors. $message$ is one of the content_*/bg_* error strings, passed through.

popover_announce_ai_unsure.description: src/content/popover.tsx announcement(): screen-reader status when the AI answered but isn't confident either. $answer$ is the AI's answer text (a card name, English, not translated here). Ends with a period (contrast with popover_ai_unsure_note, which does not).

popover_ai_unsure_note.description: src/content/popover.tsx aiControls(): visible note under the Ask AI button, same situation as popover_announce_ai_unsure but without a trailing period.

popover_ai_says_unknown.message: AI says "$answer$", which isn't in the card data.
popover_ai_says_unknown.description: src/content/popover.tsx: shown identically both in the status-region announcement and as a visible note, when the AI names a card that has no local record. $answer$ is the AI's answer text (not translated).

popover_announce_ai_says.description: src/content/popover.tsx announcement(): screen-reader status when the AI confirmed a card. Ends with a period (contrast with popover_ai_says_note).

popover_ai_says_note.description: src/content/popover.tsx aiControls(): visible note under the Ask AI button, same situation as popover_announce_ai_says but without a trailing period.

popover_label_not_sure.description: Shared short label: src/content/popover.tsx matchLine() (card tag) and announcement() (prefix of the 'closest match' sentence, popover_announce_match_result); also reused as the board state word in src/sidepanel/app.tsx BOARD_STATE_WORDS['not-sure'].

popover_label_low_match.description: Shared short label: src/content/popover.tsx announcement() (prefix of popover_announce_match_result); also reused as the board state word in src/sidepanel/app.tsx BOARD_STATE_WORDS['low'].

popover_more_matches_suffix_one.description: src/content/popover.tsx announcement(): appended (no leading space; the comma is part of this fragment) to popover_announce_match_result's $extra$ when exactly one more match is offered.

popover_more_matches_suffix_other.description: src/content/popover.tsx announcement(): appended to popover_announce_match_result's $extra$ when more than one more match is offered.

popover_announce_match_result.description: src/content/popover.tsx announcement(): screen-reader status for an unsure match. $prefix$ is popover_label_not_sure or popover_label_low_match; $name$ is the shown card's name (card data, not translated); $extra$ is '' or popover_more_matches_suffix_one/_other, composed by code.

welcome_consent_intro.description: src/welcome/copy.ts CONSENT.intro: intro line above the consent points list. Do not translate 'Duel Lens'.

welcome_consent_agree_button.description: src/welcome/copy.ts CONSENT.agree: the consent step's primary button.

welcome_consent_not_now_button.description: src/welcome/copy.ts CONSENT.notNow: button that closes the welcome tab without agreeing.

welcome_consent_done_with_shortcut.message: You're all set: press $shortcut$ on a video.
welcome_consent_done_with_shortcut.description: src/welcome/consent.tsx: shown right after the user presses 'Agree and start', when a scan shortcut is set. $shortcut$ stands in for the rendered keyboard-shortcut keycaps.

welcome_consent_done_no_shortcut.message: You're all set: click the Duel Lens icon on a video.
welcome_consent_done_no_shortcut.description: src/welcome/consent.tsx: shown right after agreeing, when no scan shortcut is set. Do not translate 'Duel Lens'.

welcome_consent_save_failed.message: Couldn't save your answer ($message$). Try again.
welcome_consent_save_failed.description: src/welcome/consent.tsx: shown when saving consent fails. $message$ is welcome_consent_no_answer_fallback, welcome_consent_unreachable_fallback, or a bg_consent_save_failed-style error passed through from the background.

welcome_consent_no_answer_fallback.description: src/welcome/consent.tsx useConsent(): fallback text (fills $message$ in welcome_consent_save_failed) when the background responded without 'ok' and without its own error text. Do not translate 'Duel Lens'.

welcome_consent_unreachable_fallback.message: Duel Lens could not be reached. Reload this page
welcome_consent_unreachable_fallback.description: src/welcome/consent.tsx useConsent(): fallback text (fills $message$ in welcome_consent_save_failed) when sending the consent message itself failed. Do not translate 'Duel Lens'.

status_loading_card_db.message: Loading the card database… (a few seconds, the first time)
status_loading_card_db.description: src/welcome/status.tsx CardDbStatus: shown on the welcome and Options pages while the bundled card data is first being loaded.

status_ready_card_db.description: src/welcome/status.tsx CardDbStatus: shown once the card database has loaded. $count$ is a locale-formatted number.

status_failed_card_db.description: src/welcome/status.tsx CardDbStatus: shown when the card database failed to load.

status_try_again_button.description: src/welcome/status.tsx CardDbStatus: retry button shown with status_failed_card_db.

shared_command_scan_card.description: src/welcome/shortcuts.tsx LABELS: display name of the 'scan-card' Chrome command, shown in Options' shortcuts list. Also the scan-card command's description on chrome://extensions/shortcuts (manifest.json).

shared_command_open_panel.description: src/welcome/shortcuts.tsx LABELS: display name of the 'open-panel' Chrome command. Also the open-panel command's description on chrome://extensions/shortcuts (manifest.json).

shared_command_execute_action.message: Scan a card (same as clicking the toolbar icon)
shared_command_execute_action.description: src/welcome/shortcuts.tsx LABELS: display name of Chrome's built-in '_execute_action' command (the toolbar icon's own shortcut), when Chrome lists it.

shared_mac_modifier_control.description: src/welcome/shortcuts.tsx MAC_MODIFIERS: spelled-out name of the ⌃ symbol in a macOS keyboard shortcut's keycaps. Mirrors macOS's own key naming; consider leaving untranslated to match the OS.

shared_mac_modifier_option.description: src/welcome/shortcuts.tsx MAC_MODIFIERS: spelled-out name of the ⌥ symbol. See shared_mac_modifier_control.

shared_mac_modifier_shift.description: src/welcome/shortcuts.tsx MAC_MODIFIERS: spelled-out name of the ⇧ symbol. See shared_mac_modifier_control.

shared_mac_modifier_command.description: src/welcome/shortcuts.tsx MAC_MODIFIERS: spelled-out name of the ⌘ symbol. See shared_mac_modifier_control.

options_shortcuts_loading.description: src/options/app.tsx ShortcutList: shown while Chrome's current shortcuts are still being read.

options_shortcut_not_set.description: src/options/app.tsx ShortcutList: shown next to a command that has no shortcut assigned. Quoted verbatim inside options_shortcuts_hint - keep the two in sync if changed.

demo_click_icon.description: src/welcome/demo.tsx: decorative illustration text (the whole demo is aria-hidden, but still visibly rendered). $icon$ stands in for the small Duel Lens icon glyph rendered inline (no text of its own).

demo_scanbar_text.message: Duel Lens · 1 card · Esc to exit
demo_scanbar_text.description: src/welcome/demo.tsx: static mock of the real scan bar's text (see content_matching_artwork/bar_card_count_one/bar_exit_hint for the real, computed equivalents) - this one is a fixed illustration string, not computed. Do not translate 'Duel Lens' or 'Esc'.

demo_card_name.description: src/welcome/demo.tsx: the made-up demo card's name, used only in the welcome page's illustration (the source comment says 'no real card's name, text or art appears'). Free to translate like ordinary UI copy, or leave as-is; it is not real card data.

demo_card_type_line.description: src/welcome/demo.tsx: the made-up demo card's type line. 'Dragon' and 'Effect' are conventional Yu-Gi-Oh! type words.

demo_card_attribute.description: src/welcome/demo.tsx: the made-up demo card's Attribute chip. Conventional Yu-Gi-Oh! attribute word (compare real attribute values, which are card data and excluded elsewhere - this one is fabricated demo content).

demo_card_level.description: src/welcome/demo.tsx: the made-up demo card's Level chip.

demo_card_atk_def.description: src/welcome/demo.tsx: the made-up demo card's ATK/DEF chip. Keep 'ATK'/'DEF' as conventional abbreviations.

demo_card_effect_text.message: Once per turn, when a card appears on your screen: you can read its name, type and full text.
demo_card_effect_text.description: src/welcome/demo.tsx: the made-up demo card's effect text (a joke on real Yu-Gi-Oh! card wording).

demo_figcaption.message: What a scan looks like: the picture freezes, you click a card, and its details appear beside it. Duel Lens stays open for the next card until you press Esc. (The card in this picture is made up.)
demo_figcaption.description: src/welcome/demo.tsx: caption under the illustration. Do not translate 'Duel Lens' or the key word 'Esc'.

popover_report_button.description: src/content/popover.tsx: button that opens the Report panel (src/content/report-panel.tsx), which sends this read to the public issue tracker. Short.

popover_report_lead.message: Send this read to the Duel Lens team. It becomes a public issue on GitHub; you need no account.
popover_report_lead.description: src/content/report-panel.tsx: first line of the Report panel.

popover_report_item_picture.description: src/content/report-panel.tsx: list item of what a report sends: the user's selection (an image).

popover_report_item_card.description: src/content/report-panel.tsx: list item of what a report sends; $name$ is the card the popover showed.

popover_report_item_no_match.description: src/content/report-panel.tsx: list item of what a report sends, when no card matched.

popover_report_item_user_card.description: src/content/report-panel.tsx: list item of what a report sends; $name$ is the other candidate the user picked.

popover_report_item_video.description: src/content/report-panel.tsx: list item of what a report sends; $time$ is the video time (h:mm:ss), $url$ its address.

popover_report_item_page.description: src/content/report-panel.tsx: list item of what a report sends, when there is no video time; $url$ is the page's address.

popover_report_item_app.message: Duel Lens's version, your browser and system
popover_report_item_app.description: src/content/report-panel.tsx: list item of what a report sends: extension version, browser and OS.

popover_report_comment_label.description: src/content/report-panel.tsx: accessible label of the report's comment box.

popover_report_comment_placeholder.message: For example: it's Ghost Ogre, glare hides the art
popover_report_comment_placeholder.description: src/content/report-panel.tsx: placeholder of the report's comment box. Short.

popover_report_public_note.message: All of this becomes public. Don't write anything personal.
popover_report_public_note.description: src/content/report-panel.tsx: warning that the report is public.

popover_report_send.description: src/content/report-panel.tsx: button that sends the report.

popover_report_sending.description: src/content/report-panel.tsx: the send button's text while sending.

popover_report_sent.description: src/content/report-panel.tsx: after sending; $number$ is the GitHub issue number.

popover_report_view.description: src/content/report-panel.tsx: link to the issue just created.

popover_report_error_consent.message: Firefox needs your permission first: allow card reports in Options.
popover_report_error_consent.description: src/content/report-panel.tsx: Firefox only, the user hasn't allowed card reports in Options yet.

popover_report_error_rate.message: Too many reports right now. Try again in a minute.

popover_report_error_daily.message: Today's reports are full. Try again tomorrow.

popover_report_error_failed.message: Couldn't send the report. Try again later.

popover_report_error_network.message: Couldn't reach the report service. Check your connection.
popover_report_error_network.description: src/content/report-panel.tsx: the relay couldn't be reached.

options_section_card_reports.description: src/options/app.tsx: Firefox only, title of the section that allows card reports.

options_card_reports_body.message: The "Report issue" button on a card sends its picture, the cards shown and the video's address to Duel Lens's public issue tracker on GitHub, only when you press Send. Firefox asks your permission once.
options_card_reports_body.description: src/options/app.tsx: Firefox only, what card reports send and when.

options_card_reports_allow.description: src/options/app.tsx: Firefox only, button that asks Firefox for the reports' data permissions.

options_card_reports_revoke.description: src/options/app.tsx: Firefox only, button that gives the permissions back.

options_card_reports_allowed.description: src/options/app.tsx: Firefox only, status when allowed.

options_card_reports_denied.message: Firefox didn't allow it. Card reports stay off.
options_card_reports_denied.description: src/options/app.tsx: Firefox only, the user declined Firefox's prompt.
